call_points.text: Target double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA, margin recovery expected as localisation scales
New Wembley facility fully operational, consolidating production lines for efficiency
Margin discipline held through volatility with calibrated pricing and sourcing optimisation
Premiumization and renovation demand remain intact, OEM business aided by furniture formalisation
FY27 capex seen at only ₹5-6 Cr for acrylic capacity; most capex done in FY26.
Acrylic localisation to start in Q1 FY27; 95% of imported products to be made in India.
Exports expected to contribute 3-4% of revenue this year, starting Q1 under Wembley Valentino.
80% of revenue from North India; focus on expanding West and South with new depots.
Inventory expected to fall ₹15-20 Cr and debtors to reduce as Wembley transition completes.
Nitrocellulose raw material shortage from supplier Nitrex affected Wembley; expected to normalise by June.

Trade receivables of ₹155.25 Cr at Mar-2026 against ₹137.73 Cr at Q2FY26.
FY26 revenue split: core Sirca ₹372 Cr (₹124 Cr imported from Italy, ₹252 Cr made in India); Wembley and Welcome ₹120.5 Cr (Welcome ₹46.5 Cr, Wembley ₹74 Cr).
Sirca core capacity 17,750 tonnes per annum after adding 1,750 tonnes; 12,000+ tonnes utilised in FY26.
Royalty to Sirca Italy is 0.75% of total reported revenue.
